'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Paragano LS Leia, Rebel Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Paragano]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Leia, Rebel Princess|Ref3-L-leiarebelprincess.gif}}
* '''Username:''' GunganStyle
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
